My publication record spans cryptography, public-key infrastructure, digital signatures, electronic documents, digital identity, post-quantum cryptography, and earlier research in computing and signal analysis.

The bibliography is maintained as a canonical scholarly-work registry. Different manifestations of the same work, such as a preprint and its final publication, are consolidated rather than counted as independent publications.
